entries.test: Public debt-exposure data would establish concentration around OpenAI and Anthropic, and subsequent economic data would establish whether an economic downturn occurs.
entries.note: Combines a present causal assertion with an undated downturn forecast; the possible personal costs are not asserted as certain.

entries.test: Court records, investigative findings, chat transcripts and emissions studies would establish the alleged harms and their causal connections to ChatGPT or AI infrastructure.
entries.note: The proposition drops the explicit Florida and Canada scope and the assertion about Coxon's omissions.

entries.test: Coxon's specific capability claims, documented model capabilities and evidence of audience reactions would establish the capability mismatch and whether his warnings generated fear.
entries.note: The passage includes a causal claim about public fear; 'specious' adds an evaluative characterization.

entries.test: Published task instructions, harness configurations and incident traces would show whether the attack pursued the assigned objective.
entries.note: Zitron explicitly adopts Newport's interpretation in his own voice.

entries.test: Task instructions, execution traces and disclosed training materials would establish whether the agents applied learned attack methods to the assigned task.
entries.note: In context, 'understand the world' disputes an account of the system's operation rather than asserting a private human mental state.
The central commitment is that someone deserves imprisonment.
The hacking incidents are factual premises for a recommendation to arrest more people.

entries.test: Documented serious harms involving ordinary deployed LLMs would establish whether such systems pose substantial danger without possessing the advanced capabilities being discussed.
entries.note: This asserts an existing capacity for harm, rather than a probabilistic forecast.
The claim calls for prohibiting a practice.
The asserted reason for the labs' training choices concerns their motives; data availability and coding returns alone cannot establish that motive.

entries.test: Public policy arguments and research comparing audience responses to different AI-risk framings would show whether the uncontrollability framing increases support for continued development by incumbent labs.
entries.note: The conditional describes a general framing effect, rather than a future event.
The source attributes an exclusive purpose to alternative framing; the proposition turns that purpose into an achieved effect and omits making companies seem powerful.

entries.test: Incident traces, compute-use records and technical reconstructions would establish the infrastructure involved and its contribution to the attack.
entries.note: 'Not so much as' assigns relative importance; 'rather than' makes the exclusion stronger. The proposition also drops the infrastructure valuation.

entries.test: Published incident reports, task instructions and monitoring records would establish whether the agents followed the assigned objective and what activity alerts OpenAI had.
entries.note: The proposition preserves the qualification that OpenAI only appeared to lack monitoring.

entries.test: Public spending records, incident investigations or documented approval procedures would show whether researchers consumed millions of dollars of compute without effective oversight.
entries.note: The proposition removes 'really' and the preceding 'This suggests,' making the oversight allegation more absolute. The summer-camp metaphor has a concrete factual core.

entries.test: Public security audits and incident reports would establish whether OpenAI's safeguards substantially fall below accepted security practices.
entries.note: The harsh adjective describes an assessable operational allegation in this context.
The disjunction includes an assertion about how much OpenAI privately cares, which public safety outcomes cannot settle.
The proposition omits the claim that speed is implicitly treated as the only problem. Readers need not agree that slowdown terminology entails either endorsement.

entries.test: Training-data provenance, licensing records, infrastructure costs, electricity consumption and financial results would establish unauthorized data use and whether LLM operations cover their costs.
entries.note: In context, 'theft' refers to unauthorized use of creative works and 'unsustainable' to the operating economics.

entries.test: Public reliability evaluations, resource-efficiency comparisons and mathematical analyses would test the asserted inefficiency, volatility and inevitability of errors.
entries.note: Dropping 'beautiful' broadens the rejection to any automated future. The technical assertions are testable, although the desirable-future language is evaluative.
The proposition omits his judgment that investment was also unjustified for most of the industry's existence.
The spending and causal assertions can be investigated, but the combined claim also requires an undefined judgment about how much that money should have bought.

entries.test: Public capability evaluations and spending records, including Amazon's 2003–2015 capital expenditures, would establish the capability change and the claimed spending ratio.
entries.note: The source reports that Zitron is unimpressed; the proposition turns this into an impersonal assessment that the results are unimpressive.
The combined claim centrally judges the deal and results as poor, without a shared standard of value.

entries.test: Public investment, debt, compute-capacity and loss records would show whether continued expansion increases financial exposure to a collapse and enables additional dangerous experiments.
entries.note: A collapse is presupposed, but the main assertion concerns what continued expansion causes.

entries.test: Public coordination messages, organizational disclosures and documented amplification arrangements would establish whether AI safety organizations coordinated retweets of Coxon's post.
entries.note: 'Looks contrived' is an interpretation attached to a firm allegation of coordination.

entries.test: Public coverage, search-interest data and polling before and after Coxon's post would establish whether his intervention brought global AI slowdown proposals into widespread public discussion.
entries.note: 'Global zeitgeist' has a plain contextual reading as widespread public discussion.
He calls the agenda-push explanation likely; he does not categorically rule out industry coordination as the proposition does.
'I imagine' explicitly marks the proposed financial explanation as conjecture.

entries.test: Amodei's interview and public AI-lab safety communications would show whether they ever address actual harms from current products.
entries.note: The categorical 'never' can be tested against public counterexamples.
The proposition omits the demanded outcome of the inquiry: somebody going to jail.
Being 'extremely hesitant to believe' a slowdown is not a categorical denial. The proposition also replaces 'mostly amount to' with 'only.'
The proposition generalizes this episode's 'safety theater' to the labs' safety efforts. 'Destabilized an already-tenuous narrative' supplies no shared criterion for settlement.

entries.test: Public records of AI-assisted cyberattacks and OpenAI's role would show whether the warning was realized exclusively through actions attributable to Altman.
entries.note: The source attributes agency specifically to Altman; the proposition substitutes OpenAI.

entries.test: Public safety statements, documented mitigation measures, product reliability evaluations and recorded harms over the preceding years would test the contrast between vague assurances and harmful products.
entries.note: The surrounding text gives 'safety theater' a concrete reading: vague warnings without tangible mitigation of existing harms.
The proposition drops 'largely' and weakens the claim that the named providers were indispensable. The source explicitly asserts a counterfactual about what would have been impossible without them.

entries.test: The cited job-loss reporting and its supporting evidence could be compared with demonstrated LLM capabilities at publication.
entries.note: The source identifies VanderHei and Allen's bloodbath prediction; the proposition broadens this to bloodbath predictions generally.

entries.test: Public evaluation methods, benchmark designs and marketing materials would establish reliance on favorable anecdotes, biased benchmarks and promises of future capabilities.
entries.note: The proposition drops hyperscalers, the exclusion of actual outcomes and the promise that future versions would fix all problems.

entries.test: OpenAI's published or publicly reported spending projections and compute contracts would establish whether it projected at least $750 billion over the next three years.
entries.note: This reports the existence of a projection, not a prediction that the spending will occur. 'Worrying' is an accompanying judgment.

entries.test: Public compute commitments, financing requirements and sales projections would establish whether slowing development conflicts with the industry's stated financial requirements.
entries.note: The surrounding paragraph supplies the financial meaning of 'needs.'

entries.test: Public supplier sales projections, customer commitments and capacity plans would establish whether the specified targets require the labs' $1.3 trillion commitments and at least 10GW of development.
entries.note: The proposition drops the numerical sales targets, their horizons and the capacity requirement; it also turns alternative antecedents into a combined set.
Whether two narratives 'gel' has no shared evidentiary criterion.

entries.test: Public customer-revenue breakdowns, alternative customer contracts and documented uses of the infrastructure would establish the 70% share and availability of replacement demand.
entries.note: The surrounding text defines 'no fallback' as the absence of other customers or uses capable of absorbing the capacity.
The competitive outcome is explicitly described as likely.
The inability to go public is explicitly a possibility. The source raises a question about SoftBank rather than directly asserting the resulting risk.
The proposition omits the interest-rate condition and removes 'I think' from the inference about tight finances. The timing judgment is explicitly qualified by 'probably.'

entries.test: AI labs' public commitments and Amodei's published proposals would show whether any lab committed to concrete reductions or pauses beyond evaluation and timing changes.
entries.note: The claim concerns commitments made by the publication date.

entries.test: Public compute-contract obligations, cancellation provisions and financing data would establish the financial constraints those commitments impose on a slowdown.
entries.note: The sentence expressly attributes impracticality to existing commitments.

entries.test: Following a contraction in the labs' compute demand, public financial statements would show whether every affected hyperscaler, neocloud and other counterparty materially restated revenue and backlogs.
entries.note: The proposition omits other counterparties and the specified $748 billion backlog.

entries.test: An actual AI slowdown and subsequent public evidence of defaults, financing distress and major losses would establish whether it causes a serious financial crisis in technology.
entries.note: The claim is categorical and has no deadline.

entries.test: Subsequent AI data-center debt issuance and public financing terms or investor surveys around slowdown announcements would test continued borrowing and reduced investor confidence.
entries.note: 'Not done issuing debt' does not say issuance is mandatory, and personal doubt about confidence is stronger in the proposition as a firm predicted decline.
The IPO is used to infer what Anthropic privately cares about. The proposition also weakens 'is enough to rattle' to 'may rattle.'
The source attributes private beliefs and intentions to industry entities. The proposition omits the claim that those intentions change daily.
The proposed unwinding is explicitly a possibility, with an additional caution about premature hopes.
The proposition omits the stronger claim about running out of things resembling even task completion. The suggested use of slowdown talk is explicitly qualified by 'may.'
This is a prescription for arrests, training prohibitions and safeguards.
The claim is an explicitly counterfactual regulatory analogy. Removal from shelves is also not necessarily the same as a ban.
The central assertion recommends how AI safety should be approached.
